description: This file provides low-level UTF handling functions, including validation of Unicode code points, reading Unicode characters from UTF-8 and UTF-16 streams, writing Unicode characters to UTF-8 and UTF-16 strings, and template functions for preparing output buffers for UTF conversions.

methods.name: IsValidCodepoint
methods.description: Checks if a Unicode code point is valid, excluding surrogate pairs and code points above U+10FFFF.

methods.name: IsValidCharacter
methods.description: Checks if a Unicode code point is a valid character, excluding non-characters and certain reserved code points.

methods.name: ReadUnicodeCharacter
methods.description: Reads a Unicode character from a UTF-8 or UTF-16 stream, updating the character index and output code point.

methods.name: WriteUnicodeCharacter
methods.description: Appends a Unicode code point as UTF-8 or UTF-16 to the output string, returning the number of bytes or 16-bit units written.

methods.name: PrepareForUTF8Output
methods.description: Prepares a std::string for UTF-8 output based on input character data.

methods.name: PrepareForUTF16Or32Output
methods.description: Prepares an output buffer for UTF-16 or UTF-32 data based on UTF-8 input.
